compute_dag.forbidden_redundancy: Do not regenerate Sionna channels separately for passes or methods.
compute_dag.rule: Generate one full 128-port cellular channel/topology bundle per seed. Derive the 64-RF architecture once and reuse it across all five pass records and all methods.

required_before_job_array_execution: independent round-2 PASS on candidate v3
immutable job-array package whose source/config hashes match candidate v3

fixed_population.interpretation: Thirty independent channel/topology seed clusters crossed with five preselected fixed protected-pass geometry blocks. The five passes are not treated as an iid sample from all possible passes.

method_contracts.causal_information: Current local CSI/load and preloaded full-pass ephemeris-derived coupling upper envelope; no future cellular-channel realization.
One static action designed from the full-pass declared upper envelope; reported as a conservative preplanned comparator.
Current interval only; no future coupling. Receives the same pre-authorized sector-selective emergency fallback.
Current interval only; no future coupling.
Current interval and queue state only.
Same interval upper envelope and fallback latency assumption.
Instantaneous exact coupling; no delay/slew penalty.

declared_engineering_envelope.interpretation: Deterministic engineering stress scenario, not a calibrated confidence bound.

load_schedule.selection_rule: For sector b and phase j, activate local streams {(b+j+r) mod 4: r=0,...,K_j-1}.
load_schedule.variable_pass_length_rule: Let N_p=ceil(S_p/5), where S_p is the protected one-second sample count. Apply declared phases in order, truncating the phase that reaches N_p. If N_p exceeds 118, append one extension phase with K=2 and phase index j=6, matching build_rotating_load_schedule(). The last update interval may be shorter than five seconds and uses the exact available samples.

moving_average_pf.initialization: per-seed full-load nominal total-band user rates

statistics.claim_scope: Inference is over the predeclared 30 channel/topology seeds averaged across these five fixed geometry passes; it is not a population claim over all orbital passes or ephemeris uncertainty.
statistics.confidence_interval: paired percentile bootstrap over 30 seed clusters
statistics.go_condition: All hard gates pass and the lower 95% paired seed-cluster bootstrap bound for the primary moving-PF utility difference is greater than zero.
hard_gates: zero predictive hard-safety violation seconds across all 150 cells
zero predictive eligible-floor violation user-seconds across all 150 cells
statistics.missing_run_policy: No imputation or silent exclusion. A deterministic failed cell may be rerun once with the identical immutable inputs. Persistent failure leaves the campaign incomplete and blocks the go decision.
statistics.multiplicity: One confirmatory utility comparison. All other comparisons and sensitivity effects are secondary/exploratory.
statistics.pass_treatment: Fixed blocking factor. Do not bootstrap five passes as if they were an iid population sample.
statistics.primary_estimand: For each seed s, average the paired moving-PF utility difference over the five fixed pass blocks; estimate the mean over the 30 seeds.
